notes.title: Update 0.2!
notes.notes:
Hi! This is the first major update I've made since returning from my break. I spent a few days working on all these changes, so I hope you enjoy them!


VERY IMPORTANT
TO PLAY THIS UPDATE, YOU MUST DELETE YOUR SAVE FILE. THIS CAN BE FOUND IN C:\\Users\\\\Documents\\Cargo\\Saves. IF YOU DO NOT DELETE YOUR SAVE, THE GAME WILL NOT FUNCTION (This is not intentional)


Changes
Added inventory system (very big!!)

Added new tools and resources (not usable yet, but will be in the future!)

Fixed save system (A few small bugs)

Added new data to save

Fixed XP gain (XP is now more difficult to get, hopefully)

Added sleeping and beds (To sleep, it has to be past 18:00, there currently is no clock, but I'm planning to add that next update)


Reporting Bugs
If you wish to report a bug to me, join the Discord by clicking the button below and fill out a report in #bugs.

Click to join


Suggesting Changes/Features
You can suggest a feature on the Google Form by clicking the button below.

Submit a Feature



Have fun and happy gaming!!

notes.title: Experimental Update 1
notes.notes:
Hi! I've decided to push out the first experimental update on the Experimental Branch.

If you would like to try it out, you can do so in the Betas tab of the properties page of Cargo.


This update is now available on the default branch

VERY IMPORTANT
TO PLAY THIS UPDATE, YOU MUST DELETE YOUR SAVE FILE. THIS CAN BE FOUND IN C:\\Users\\\\Documents\\Cargo\\Saves. IF YOU DO NOT DELETE YOUR SAVE, THE GAME WILL NOT FUNCTION (This is not intentional)


Changes
Added animations to the player model, including grabbing and dropping. (I WAS SO EXCITED FOR HOW IT TURNED OUT SO ENJOY!!!)

Added day/night cycle along with custom skybox

Added more shop items (Speed Shoes, Stamina Soda)

Added a map (Open with M), this should make it easier to find Customer locations.

Removed Minimap in favor of the map

Added Customer icon to map (When you collect a package or grab one from your backpack, it will create a blue icon on the map above the location you must deliver to)

Added a crosshair (So it is easier to look at and collect packages that are dropped)

Added new save data terms (Player Location, Current Package (Package in your hand), Backpack Packages)


Reporting Bugs
If you wish to report a bug to me, join the Discord by clicking the button below and fill out a report in #bugs.

Click to join


Official Cargo OST
The Cargo OST Album is out now on Spotify, Apple Music, iTunes, and any other mainstream provider! You can check it out on Spotify by clicking the link below.

https://open.spotify.com/album/2S3Uc5eAaFzjCGbTgnv0UW?si=WMOdTWdjQi-53r2QeCl8Bg



I've had so much fun working on Cargo, even though we've had some tough times. I can't wait for the adventures we have together in the future. Have fun and happy gaming!!

notes.title: CARGO IS RELEASE
notes.notes:
I kinda overestimated how much time it would take to get Cargo release ready. BUT IT'S OUT NOW ON EARLY ACCESS. I honestly don't even know what to say with this. This has been my dream game to create, even though it's not fully finished. It is finished enough though that I think everyone would enjoy playing it. I plan to release multiplayer and several other features in the coming months, especially during the summer when I'm not busy with school. 

You can track my progress with the game on Trello here.

If you want to suggest features or report bugs, join the Discord here.

Happy Gaming!!!

notes.title: CARGO HAS BEEN APPROVED FOR RELEASE
notes.notes: It's official! Cargo has been approved for release by Steam and should be available for purchase sometime this week! I have poured so much time into this project and can't wait to get it out there for everyone to play. Just have fun! :3

notes.title: Our Progress (and when the next update is released)
notes.notes:
I'd like to take a minute to talk about our progress in the game and make some announcements.

The Future of Killswitch Games
As you may know from my last post for the 2.0A update, I am a solo developer for Killswitch (my company). Not anymore, technically. I have started working with one of my closest IRL friends on map design and the story for Cargo. She is working under Killswitch Games but she is not working for me. I'd also like to announce that Killswitch Games is currently in the process of being renamed to Floppy Fish Studios. I'd like to focus on creating silly goofy fun games for everyone to play. And I think that the name Killswitch is too... Violent? Especially for the type of games I work on.

When should you expect Cargo to be released?
I plan to release Cargo sometime during the summer this year at the earliest, this could extend into fall but it is unlikely. After the release, we will definitely keep making updates. This is my first ever game, so I plan to put everything into it. 

Our Next Project
For our next project, Silly Cat Game. Which is pretty self explanatory. I have worked on it a little bit during my downtime working on Cargo. But i'm not going to fully commit to it till after I fully publish Cargo. Also, SCG will be created in Godot which should help with lag and such stuff. I will have to figure out how to integrate it onto Steam but once I work on it and get a first release for it, it will be on itch.io for free.

Contact & Recommendations
If you have any questions about Cargo and want to recommend some features or game ideas to us, shoot me a message on Discord (scythepng) or join our Discord.

I love making this game and I hope I can release it soon. I want you guys to have fun while playing this.

Enjoy the singleplayer while I fix multiplayer!
